platforms.boardDetails: 64 × 50 mm · 2 layers · 85 components · ground pours on both layers
platforms.boardFeatures: RP2040 with 2 MB flash, two DRV8837 motor drivers, two quadrature encoder inputs, LSM6DS3TR-C IMU, four servo headers, USB-C power/programming and GPIO expansion. Motor/power section separated from MCU/sensors. Assumes 5–9 V motors and separate regulated 5 V servo input; USB powers logic only. Initial ground fanout uses autoroutingphase, followed by local routing and local geometry repairs; checked source replays verified routes. Final digital checks: zero routing/placement errors and copper shorts, all ground pads connected. Prototype outputs; motor current, thermal behavior, USB signal integrity and assembly remain unverified.

platforms.boardDetails: 70 × 60 mm · 2 layers · 79 components including mounting holes · ground pours on both layers
platforms.boardFeatures: RP2040 with 2 MB flash, two DRV8871 motor drivers, two quadrature encoder inputs, LSM6DS3 IMU, three servo headers, USB-C power/programming and GPIO expansion. Motor/power section separated from MCU/sensors. External 7–12 V motor and 5–6 V servo supplies; USB powers logic only. Original complete project: zero DRC violations, unconnected items and schematic parity issues; one intentional ERC warning for the IMU address strap. Prototype; electrical, thermal and USB performance are unverified. Detailed phase timing is reconstructed from tool checkpoints in PR #11; the 23 min 6 s total is measured.
